newsitem.title: USA: Barnes & Noble CFO/Vice Chairman resigns.
newsitem.headline: Barnes & Noble CFO/Vice Chairman resigns.

text.p: Barnes & Noble Inc on Wednesday said Irene Miller has resigned as vice chairman and chief financial officer.
Miller will remain a director of the company, it said.
Miller, who had had been with Barnes & Noble for about seven years, wanted to pursue other personal and business interests, the company said in a release.
Miller's financial duties will be assumed by William Duffy, who has been named chief accounting officer, the company said. Duffy had been vice president for finance.
